microphonePermissionHint: Please allow microphone access in the browser prompt.
recordingProcessFailed: The recording could not be processed.
recordingRunningHint: The selected microphone is being recorded locally in your browser.
recordingStoppingHint: The audio file is being prepared.
selectInputDeviceHint: Select an input device and start recording.
selectMicrophoneBelow: Select a microphone below and press Start recording.
selectMicrophoneHint: Select a microphone and start recording.
takesHint: Recordings stay only in this browser window until you upload them.
uploadUnavailable: Uploading becomes possible once speech recognition is set up.
connectingHint: The live transcription is connecting to the service.
liveRunningHint: The microphone is transcribed live and recorded locally in your browser at the same time.
liveUnavailable: No service is set up for live transcription yet.

asrBaseUrl.label: Speech recognition address
asrBaseUrl.hint: OpenAI-compatible endpoint up to /v1, such as Speaches. Transcription uses POST /audio/transcriptions (verbose_json with segments).

providerName.label: Provider name
providerName.hint: Saved with every transcription, such as KI@JLU.

asrModels.label: Speech models
asrModels.hint: At most {{max}}. The list can be fetched from the endpoint; display names you gave stay.

defaultAsrModel.label: Speech model of jobs
defaultAsrModel.hint: Without a choice, the first of the list.

diarizationEnabled.label: Recognise speakers
diarizationEnabled.hint: Analyses the voices before transcribing, so they can be named. Without it, no text has a speaker.

diarizationUrl.label: Speaker recognition address
diarizationUrl.hint: HTTP endpoint that takes the audio file and returns the speakers' turns.

diarizationModel.label: Speaker recognition model
diarizationModel.hint: Only needed if the endpoint expects one.

llmBaseUrl.label: AI endpoint address
llmBaseUrl.hint: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint up to /v1 for correction, summaries, subtitles and speaker optimisation.

llmModels.label: AI models
llmModels.hint: At most {{max}}. The list can be fetched from the endpoint; display names you gave stay. Only listed models are used.

defaultCorrectionModel.label: Correction model
defaultCorrectionModel.hint: Without a choice, the first of the list.

defaultSummaryModel.label: Summary model
defaultSummaryModel.hint: Without a choice, the first of the list.

admin.fetchedModelsOmitted_one: {{count}} more above the maximum of {{max}} left out.
admin.fetchedModelsOmitted_other: {{count}} more above the maximum of {{max}} left out.

fetchModelsErrors.failed: The models could not be fetched. Check the address and the API key.

defaultLanguage.label: Language
defaultLanguage.hint: What new uploads start with; people can change it.

defaultSpeakerCount.label: Number of speakers
defaultSpeakerCount.hint: What new uploads start with; people can change it.

defaultLlmCorrection.label: AI correction on by default
defaultLlmCorrection.hint: Only takes effect when an AI endpoint with models is set up.

maxDurationMinutes.label: Longest recording (minutes)
maxDurationMinutes.hint: Empty: no limit besides the file size.

maxActiveJobsPerUser.label: Running jobs per person
maxActiveJobsPerUser.hint: Jobs uploading, being analysed or transcribed at the same time.

chunkSeconds.label: Chunk length (seconds)
chunkSeconds.hint: Long recordings are cut into chunks of this length before recognition.

upstreamTimeoutSeconds.label: Time limit per request (seconds)
upstreamTimeoutSeconds.hint: How long a request to speech recognition, speaker recognition or the AI endpoint may take.

transcriptRetentionHours.label: Delete saved transcripts after (hours)
transcriptRetentionHours.hint: Counted from the last change. Empty: they stay until the person deletes them.

unsavedJobRetentionHours.label: Delete unsaved jobs after (hours)
unsavedJobRetentionHours.hint: Failed and cancelled ones too, each with its audio.

realtimeModes.label: Offered modes
realtimeModes.hint: Local needs the bridge's signaling address, OpenAI the API key for OpenAI Realtime.

defaultRealtimeMode.label: Default mode
defaultRealtimeMode.hint: Without a choice, the first one offered.

onpremSignalingUrl.label: Bridge signaling address
onpremSignalingUrl.hint: Takes the browser's SDP offer and answers with the bridge's SDP; the server passes both on.

iceServers.label: ICE servers
iceServers.hint: One server per line, several addresses separated by spaces, such as turn:turn.uni-giessen.de:3478. At most 5, for the local mode only.

openaiRealtimeUrl.label: OpenAI API address
openaiRealtimeUrl.hint: Up to /v1. The server gets short-lived keys there; browsers send their SDP offer to /realtime/calls.

openaiRealtimeModel.label: OpenAI transcription model
openaiRealtimeModel.hint: Set at the start of every session.

admin.storageHint: Storage is set up with the server's TRANSCRIPTION_S3_* environment variables. Without storage, no uploads are possible.

test.error: The test could not be run.

findings.modelMissing: The endpoint does not list the model {{model}}.
